captureConditions: Intended release version/build and exact source identity recorded.
Ordinary app state with no acceptance fixture flag.
Non-sensitive reviewer-owned demonstration data; no personal CV, account screen, credentials or pairing code.
Retain truthful job source, availability and disabled live-submission state.
Preserve original captures; do not retouch QA screenshots or invent application receipts.
remainingCapturePlan.note: The original proposed sequence is retained below. The accepted iPhone sequence is Start, public results, public opportunity and local application workspace; the actual evidence is in captureFollowups. Remaining work is publisher configuration/review, not another scheduled capture.

scopeLimits: The initial artwork review was read-only for app/runtime state. Separately authorized Android emulator and GitHub-hosted iPhone simulator capture follow-ups are recorded below.
Android used the unchanged published preview APK. iPhone built the exact verified production inputs in unsigned Release with isolated capture-only test wiring; no production app code changed.
No general acceptance suite was rerun for these captures. The iPhone artifact walkthrough is separate from the five-job quality gate.
No physical phone, shared local Apple tool, signing, pairing, personal account/profile/CV, employer submission or store action was used for the captures.
All originals are preserved. Android RGB copies remove only fully opaque alpha with identical RGB pixels; iPhone candidates are the original unchanged RGB PNGs.
Technical format checks and root visual acceptance do not establish store approval or a signed release. The current hosted preview keeps live submissions disabled.
Public provenance uses repository paths, artifact identities and content hashes without personal-machine paths or credentials.
No new simulator, physical-device, build, signing, account or store action was performed.
No existing screenshot was copied over, cropped, retouched or transformed.
Image format validity does not establish release eligibility or store approval.
The current hosted preview keeps live submissions disabled.
Repository paths and CI artifact identities provide provenance without personal-machine absolute paths.
